content: 第一关（后）
7:55 A.M. \ Overcast

raw: [name=""]   Rhodes Island Cabin #7, Lok Tai Chau, Lungmen Harbor
content: Rhodes Island Cabin #7, Lok Tai Chau, Lungmen Harbor

raw: [name="Swire"]   I teamed up with Rhodes Island to clear out the Reunion forces that were blocking your way. Your squad is pretty much fine as well. Heheh~ You can finally go back to Lungmen.
speaker: Swire
content: I teamed up with Rhodes Island to clear out the Reunion forces that were blocking your way. Your squad is pretty much fine as well. Heheh~ You can finally go back to Lungmen.

raw: [name="Swire"]   Just when you thought that everything had settled down, you took a blast head-on and got knocked out.
speaker: Swire
content: Just when you thought that everything had settled down, you took a blast head-on and got knocked out.

speaker: Ch'en
content: ...Really?

raw: [name="Swire"]   Are you asking if you really let someone sneak up on you like that, or if you really managed to get hit with explosives but only end up unconscious?
speaker: Swire
content: Are you asking if you really let someone sneak up on you like that, or if you really managed to get hit with explosives but only end up unconscious?

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Forget it, stop pulling my leg. What's the situation in Lungmen now?
speaker: Ch'en
content: Forget it, stop pulling my leg. What's the situation in Lungmen now?

raw: [name="Swire"]   It's a terrible mess. Read the report yourself if you'd like.
speaker: Swire
content: It's a terrible mess. Read the report yourself if you'd like.

raw: [name="Swire"]   Regardless of what happened before, the fact is that our counterattack has been significantly set back because of you.
speaker: Swire
content: Regardless of what happened before, the fact is that our counterattack has been significantly set back because of you.

raw: [name="Swire"]   Right now, the Special Ops Division should be assembling the remainder of your squad, then joining up with the rest of the L.G.D. along with Rhodes Island.
speaker: Swire
content: Right now, the Special Ops Division should be assembling the remainder of your squad, then joining up with the rest of the L.G.D. along with Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Hoshiguma"]   So we'll be fighting our way straight to the heart of the city. Maneuver warfare, huh? That does seem promising.
speaker: Hoshiguma
content: So we'll be fighting our way straight to the heart of the city. Maneuver warfare, huh? That does seem promising.

raw: [name="Hoshiguma"]   What's the purpose of that kind of strategy though?
speaker: Hoshiguma
content: What's the purpose of that kind of strategy though?

raw: [name="Swire"]   Destroying all of Reunion's rally points. We'll fully utilize the advantage you've created for us.
speaker: Swire
content: Destroying all of Reunion's rally points. We'll fully utilize the advantage you've created for us.

speaker: Hoshiguma
content: In other words, a siege.

raw: [name="Swire"]   That's right, we have to seize this opportunity when Reunion is still trying to establish a foothold.
speaker: Swire
content: That's right, we have to seize this opportunity when Reunion is still trying to establish a foothold.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   However, in doing so, we'll be forcing their remnants to converge faster.
speaker: Ch'en
content: However, in doing so, we'll be forcing their remnants to converge faster.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   You can't guarantee that you'll be able to hold them off until the L.G.D. is reassembled, much less ensure that the Reunion remnants are all dealt with.
speaker: Ch'en
content: You can't guarantee that you'll be able to hold them off until the L.G.D. is reassembled, much less ensure that the Reunion remnants are all dealt with.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   We don't need any of your 'advantages,' nor do I need to hear you lecture me about strategies.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We don't need any of your 'advantages,' nor do I need to hear you lecture me about strategies.

raw: [name="Swire"]   You don't have a say in the matter, Ch'en. Even if you are the head of the Special Ops Divison and enjoy a certain degree of autonomy during times of war, you cannot absolve yourself of all accountability.
speaker: Swire
content: You don't have a say in the matter, Ch'en. Even if you are the head of the Special Ops Divison and enjoy a certain degree of autonomy during times of war, you cannot absolve yourself of all accountability.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   Judging by your tone, you're trying to challenge me. I'll take you on, but not right now.
speaker: Ch'en
content: Judging by your tone, you're trying to challenge me. I'll take you on, but not right now.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]   We each have our own orders. The only thing that matters is that we do our job.
speaker: Ch'en
content: We each have our own orders. The only thing that matters is that we do our job.

raw: [name="Swire"]   Ch'en, the L.G.D. has fallen, and Reunion has taken control of the L.G.D. Headquarters. This is your fault.
speaker: Swire
content: Ch'en, the L.G.D. has fallen, and Reunion has taken control of the L.G.D. Headquarters. This is your fault.

raw: [name="Swire"]   Why were you not here when Lungmen needed you?
speaker: Swire
content: Why were you not here when Lungmen needed you?

speaker: Swire
content: Was that also an order?

raw: [name="Swire"]   If you weren't neglecting your duties, Lungmen wouldn't have fallen.
speaker: Swire
content: If you weren't neglecting your duties, Lungmen wouldn't have fallen.

raw: [name="Swire"]   I'm ashamed of you, Ch'en. You should resign immediately, and let me take over the Special Ops Division.
speaker: Swire
content: I'm ashamed of you, Ch'en. You should resign immediately, and let me take over the Special Ops Division.
